<div class="card-body">
'''Precise Attack''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">正確な射撃</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">いずれかの位置カード上での戦闘において、その場所にある自分の武器を２つ以上同時に用い、武器運命数を合計して単独のキャラクターかビークルを攻撃することができる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「帝国軍のストームトルーパーでなければ、これほど正確には仕留められぬ。」</span>''

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Accurate Shooting.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' During a battle at any location card, you may simultaneously use two or more of your weapons at that location, totaling their weapon destiny to attack a single character or vehicle.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' Only Imperial stormtroopers could bring them down this accurately.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says location card rather than site and expressly says to use the weapons simultaneously and total weapon destiny to attack one target. The printed English says to target one character or vehicle by combining the destiny draws of two or more weapons at the same site. The Japanese lore refers to bringing the victims down accurately, while the English says only that Imperial stormtroopers are so precise.<ref name="comparison-video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=336 Precise Attack Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 5:36.</ref>

<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Precise Attack]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-premiere-japanese/imagegallery/724984 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/202709159/qQT4ZPl640O0vNvy5VIVDw.jpg Precise Attack original photograph].</ref>
